errors.text: The proposed rapid-solidification and BCC/B2 precipitation route does not reconstruct the key intervention: addition of 4.2 at.% Cr by vacuum arc melting.
The asserted B2 precipitates, including an Al-rich chemistry, are unsupported and partly compositionally impossible because the proposed Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr alloy contains no Al.

The baseline is mischaracterized as a continuous-B2, >2000 MPa, <5% ductility alloy; the target baseline is an as-cast single-phase BCC alloy with approximately 11.6% fracture strain and density of 10.44 g/cm³.

Heat treatment and rapid solidification cannot materially reduce the intrinsic density of an unchanged equiatomic composition. Comparison with W-based RHEAs does not address the stated density limitation of the HfMoTaTiZr baseline.
Evidence from Al0.5NbTa0.8Ti1.5V0.2Zr does not establish that Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr has the required B2 phase field, order-disorder transition, or elemental partitioning.
